# GBR Electrical Services, LLC

> Licensed electrical contractor and authorized Kohler whole-home generator dealer based in Dover, PA, serving York County, Pennsylvania for over 40 years. Services include electrical repairs, panel upgrades, wiring and lighting, EV charger installation, and Kohler standby generator installation and maintenance.

Address: 5605 Fish and Game Road, Dover, PA 17315
Phone: 717-467-1712 (office), 717-515-1504 (cell / emergency)
Email: info@lightsonpa.com
Service area: Dover, York, Dillsburg, Mechanicsburg, Red Lion, Spring Grove, Hanover, Manchester, New Cumberland, Lewisberry, Wrightsville, East Berlin, Camp Hill, Etters, and all of York County, PA.
